evals.prompt: Write me a launch announcement post for my new library.
evals.expected_output: Should refuse the announcement format and explain that 'I built X' is an ad that asks for attention without offering anything. Should ask what specific hard-won undocumented finding came out of building it. Should note that if there is no finding, there may not be a post yet. Should place the link in the reply on X and nowhere in a LinkedIn post body.
assertions: Requires a specific finding rather than an announcement, and says there may be no post if none exists
Says there may not be a post if no finding exists
Offers hook options across different patterns

evals.prompt: I'll write one post and cross-post it to X, LinkedIn, and my newsletter to save time.
evals.expected_output: Should warn that verbatim duplication is associated with ~65% organic traffic decline after six months and that native means rewritten, not reformatted. Should give the pillar-atomize-distribute loop and describe what the same idea becomes on each platform. Should recommend canonical tags pointing at the user's own domain when syndicating.
assertions: Explains native means rewritten not reformatted
Maps the idea to each platform's native form
Notes Medium strips canonical tags on manual paste
